notes.title: To Be Headed Or Not To Be But To Be Free !
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

[i]To Be Headed Or Not To Be[/i] just just blew its first candle ! A year ago, Fruits of Yggdrasil studio was releasing its first game. It was an intense and exciting adventure and we hope those of you who bought the game enjoyed it.

And to these people, I would like to say a huge [b][i]thank you[/i][/b] for taking the risk of buying a game from an unknown indie developer. It is not an easy commitment to do and for that I am very grateful. Thanks to you, I discovered the stress of having to watch players dismember the game mechanics in very creative ways but mostly the joy of reading positive comments from random unknown people on the internet. Obviously not everyone enjoyed the game, and some voiced this in quite unpleasant fashion, but the game was mostly well welcomed and this reinforced my desire to continue producing enjoyable adventures for you. 

And for that I am deeply grateful.

Now, I am working on the next fruit of my studio's tree with [i]The Amulet of AmunRuuUUUN[/i] and I feel it is time to give more players the opportunity to discover and enjoy this headless but heartful enigma game that is [i]To Be Headed Or Not To Be[/i].

Thus for those of you who have not bought the game yet, if you'd like to support the studio you can still do it:
First, by buying the game at full price until Sunday 29th of November. 
Then if you find the price to high or just would like to enjoy it cheaper. [i]To Be Headed Or Not To Be[/i] is gonna enter its last sale, from Sunday 29th to Friday 4th you will be able buy the game at 50% in a 2 for 1 deal (ideal for a coop game).
Finally, from Friday 4th and onwards, [i]To Be Headed Or Not To Be[/i] is simply going to be free for everyone to enjoy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35977206/30c1b8ec7a6df34937b3c3aaa943161a6c2e404a.png[/img]

This game was a really interesting journey and I really appreciate the destination its reaching, I hope all the players, past and future, will enjoy it as much as I enjoyed developing it.

If you enjoy this kind of game, check out our next creation [i]The Amulet Of AmunRuuUUUN[/i]. This one is going to be about two archaeologist students discovering the depths of an egyptian pyramid. The game is still in development but I post regular updates on our Twitter and monthly ones on steam to keep you up to date. There is also a small demo you can try out to get a flavour of this next adventure.

Have a nice day and take care !

notes.title: New Adventure Incoming !
notes.content:
Hi to all of you adventurers !

Fruits of Yggdrasil Studio is proud to announce that we are now working on [b]our next adventure[/b] !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35977206/c7c5bd3459731c615ed481f80ed9c37ee545822e.jpg[/img]

You enjoy diving deep into [b]ancient pyramids[/b] filled with traps ? Running for your life while debating about how to open the next door is your favourite sport ? You wish to have [b]Indiana Jones and Lara Croft[/b] for professors ?
Well, then prepare your boots and your brushes because this next adventure is for you. Similarly to [i]To Be Headed Or Not To Be[/i], it is going to be a 2 players cooperative escape game for you to enjoy with a friend but this time with more sand between your toes !

The game development is on its way and if you'd like to follow it's development. You can check the [url=https://www.fruitsofyggdrasil.com/project-a]official website[/url] and subscribe to the newsletter to not miss any important news. If you'd like more regular news, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/fruitsyggdrasil]twitter[/url] where we regularly keep you informed about the status.

As a last gift, here is a work-in-progress image of the first chamber you'll find yourself in ! There is still a lot of work to go in this but it is starting to come together nicely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35977206/67d74c40527ac0d9a141778f9ea6c3fdddb67eec.jpg[/img]

Have a nice day and take care !

notes.title: Stuttering Mouse Problem Fixed
notes.content:
Hello headless gamers !

Multiple instances of the second player (ie the one joining the game) having smoothness problem have been reported. This morning a patch fixing this situation has been developed and tested. The game should be now much more enjoyable for everyone. 

Thanks for your patience and special thanks to the players who reported and helped fixing the problem.
